question.description: The question to ask the user

label.description: Short display label for this option

description.description: Optional one-line description shown below the label

options.description: Between 2 and 5 answer options. A free-form 'write my own answer' option is always appended automatically - never include one yourself.

command.description: Shell command line to run in the background (sh -c on POSIX, cmd.exe /d /s /c on Windows). It receives no stdin (EOF immediately); interactive commands will not work.

title.description: Short human-readable name shown in listings and the UI

limit.description: Maximum pages to crawl. Defaults to 20; maximum 100.

maxDiscoveryDepth.description: Maximum link-discovery depth from the starting URL.

includePaths.description: URL pathname regex patterns to include.

excludePaths.description: URL pathname regex patterns to exclude.

crawlEntireDomain.description: Allow sibling and parent paths on the same domain.

onlyMainContent.description: Extract only each page's main content. Defaults to true.

timeout.description: Maximum crawl wait time in seconds. Defaults to 120.

pattern.description: Regex matched against file names (or a glob when glob is true). Omit to list everything under path.

path.description: Directory to search. Defaults to the current working directory.

type.description: Only return entries of this type: file, directory, or symlink.

extension.description: Only return files with this extension, e.g. 'ts' or 'md'.

glob.description: Treat pattern as a glob (e.g. '*.test.ts') instead of a regex.

hidden.description: Include hidden files and directories. Defaults to false.

limit.description: Maximum number of results (1-10000). Defaults to 1000.

pattern.description: Regex to search for (literal text when fixed_strings is true).

path.description: File or directory to search. Defaults to the current working directory.

glob.description: Only search files matching this glob, e.g. '*.ts' or 'src/**'.

file_type.description: Only search files of this ripgrep type, e.g. 'ts', 'js', 'py', 'rust'.

case_sensitive.description: true forces case-sensitive matching, false forces case-insensitive. Defaults to smart-case.

fixed_strings.description: Treat pattern as a literal string instead of a regex.

hidden.description: Search hidden files and directories. Defaults to false.

context.description: Lines of context to show around each match (0-20).

limit.description: Maximum matches per file (1-1000). Defaults to 100.

onlyMainContent.description: Return only the main page content. Defaults to true.

waitFor.description: Milliseconds to wait before capture, useful for JavaScript-heavy pages.

timeout.description: Request timeout in milliseconds. Defaults to 30000.

includeMetadata.description: Append page metadata to the markdown. Defaults to false; metadata remains available in tool details.

limit.description: Maximum number of results. Defaults to 5.

scrapeResults.description: Whether to include markdown scraped from each result. Defaults to false.

prompt.description: Task prompt for the subagent. Must be self-contained: include all needed context, file paths, and what to report back.

name.description: Short human-readable name for this subagent, shown in listings and the UI

harness.description: Harness to run the subagent on: "pi" (in-process pi session; inherits this environment), "claude" (Claude Code), or "codex" (Codex CLI). Choose deliberately per task.

working_dir.description: Trusted working directory for the autonomous child (default: current working directory)

model.description: Model hint, interpreted by the chosen harness (pi: "provider/model-id" or model id; claude: model alias like "sonnet"/"opus"; codex: model slug). Omit for the harness default (pi inherits the current model).

reasoning_effort.description: Reasoning effort on a shared scale; the harness maps it to its nearest native equivalent (pi thinking level, codex reasoning effort, claude thinking budget). Omit for the harness default (pi inherits the current level).

ids.description: Subagent ids to wait for, e.g. ["sa-1", "sa-2"]

script.description: JavaScript workflow script. May start with `export const meta = {...}`, then use phase(), agent(), parallel(), args, and a final `return`.

args.description: Optional JSON string exposed to the script as `args` (parsed when valid JSON, otherwise passed through as the raw string).

background.description: Run in the background: the tool returns a run id immediately and you receive a follow-up message when the workflow finishes. Defaults to false (blocking with live progress).
